concerns.text: T009 is tagged [P] and can run in parallel with T008, but it 're-run[s] the amplitude extraction' and 're-run[s] with an alternative mask threshold'. If these re-runs invoke the T003 pipeline functions that write `data/processed/pseudo_cl_results.json` / `healpix_map.fits` / `null_distribution.csv` in place, they will clobber the very artifacts T008 (running concurrently) reads to produce figures. The task must state that sensitivity re-runs write to isolated outputs (e.g. `sensitivity_checks.json` only, or temp paths), otherwise the [P] tag implies a hidden ordering requirement vs T008.

T002 references 'the truncated file from the rejected T007' and 'the rejected T004' — task IDs that no longer exist in this document (current T004/T007 are different tasks). Confusing dangling references; renumber or drop.
